stages.name: Day one - as bought
stages.summary: The house as the agent's plan draws it: sitting room, hall and family room at the front, kitchen and dining room behind, a single-storey store and lean-to at the back, four bedrooms and a small bathroom upstairs, under a slate roof with a gable and chimney at the west end and a hip at the east.

variants.name: Empty shell
variants.summary: The house on the day the keys arrive: nothing in it.

variants.name: The fittings in the photos
variants.summary: Only what the particulars show fixed in place: the kitchen's sink under the rear window and the bathroom's suite. Whether any of it works is unconfirmed (the agent says the kitchen is not functional).

stages.name: S1 - Kitchen-diner, boot room, WC and utility
stages.summary: The kitchen and dining room opened into one kitchen-diner across the garden side (about 25.5 m2), and the store and lean-to rebuilt on their own footprint as a boot room by the back door, a downstairs WC and a utility. First floor unchanged.

variants.name: Lived in
variants.summary: S1 furnished: a kitchen run under the rear window, a range on the kitchen end, a table at the dining end, a bench by the back door, and the WC and utility fitted.

stages.name: S2a - En-suite to bedroom 1, from bedroom 4
stages.summary: S1, plus an en-suite to bedroom 1 taken from the west end of bedroom 4 and entered through a new door in bedroom 1's south wall. Bedroom 4 stays, smaller, as a study or nursery. Inside the existing footprint: building control only.

variants.name: Lived in
variants.summary: S2a furnished: S1, plus the en-suite fitted and bedroom 4 as a study.

stages.name: S2b - Two-storey addition with an en-suite to bedroom 3
stages.summary: S1, plus a first floor built over the old store (about 2.7 x 2.4m outside) holding an en-suite to bedroom 3, under its own gabled slate roof tied into the main roof. Needs planning permission and counts towards the National Park's 30% limit.

variants.name: Lived in
variants.summary: S2b furnished: S1, plus the en-suite over the store fitted.
